name: cockroach
description: cockroach — CockroachDB SQL shell and CLI. Run distributed SQL queries, manage clusters, perform migrations.

install_steps: curl -LO https://binaries.cockroachdb.com/cockroach-v25.1.0.linux-amd64.tgz && tar xzf cockroach-v25.1.0.linux-amd64.tgz && sudo mv cockroach-v25.1.0.linux-amd64/cockroach /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf cockroach-v25.1.0.linux-amd64*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub or official packages.
